_comment: Per-crate line-coverage floors, in percent. Seeded at what each crate actually measured when this file was created (#98) -- a floor that started above today's coverage would fail on day one for no reason, so this is a ratchet: raising a floor is a deliberate commit, never the seed. Only the pure/logic crates CLAUDE.md calls out get a floor: scripts/coverage.sh only ever measures the crates listed here. A crate like postio-gtk, whose tests need a compositor, is deliberately left out rather than given a low floor -- a single global number across crates this different is exactly the vanity metric #98 exists to avoid.
